trigger: Audit of the claim that the low events-per-variable (EPV) count arose from a JBLAB/IM patient-ID mis-join.

join_audit.verdict: NO mis-join. Prefixes are clean timepoint partitions, consistent with manuscript 2.1 (timepoints assigned only from the manifest time_point field).

pseudoreplication.issue: Manuscript cross-sectional arm is scored at PROFILE level (n=86, 9 resistant). Profiles from the same patient are not independent, so profile-level n and p-values are inflated.

material_findings: The manuscript's reported Mann-Whitney significance (breakpoints p=0.030, sd_seg p=0.0094) and the derived BH q-values (0.046, 0.028) DO NOT SURVIVE de-duplication: both become p=0.0738 at patient level and are non-significant.
Manuscript EPV=9 overstates independent power. True independent EPV is 4 (all timepoints, patient level) or 3 (diagnosis-timepoint only).
EPV=3 is therefore REPRODUCIBLE as the correct diagnosis-timepoint independent-unit count. It is not the product of a mis-join.
The manuscript's directional conclusion (pre-specified criterion NOT met; discovery-only) is UNCHANGED and remains correct. Only the specific inferential statistics require correction.
recommended_manuscript_actions: Section 3.3 / Table: report patient-level statistics as primary, or explicitly label the profile-level analysis as pseudo-replicated.
Withdraw the 'two features' CIs exclude 0.5' and BH q<0.05 claims as artifacts of profile-level counting.
Restate EPV as 4 (patient level) / 3 (diagnosis only), not 9.
Resolve the 8 unlinked profiles before any refresh.

scope_reconciliation.273_patients_66_resistant: Full BriTROC-1 CLINICAL cohort under sensitivity-at-registration. Not CN-profiled here.
scope_reconciliation.98_samples_20_resistant: Separate gene-level dataset (CCNE1/KRAS/MYC/ERBB2/LST/FGA) from the published absolute-CN table; not this QDNAseq snapshot.
scope_reconciliation.94_profiles_65_patients_4_resistant: This DAC-authorized sWGS snapshot, primary-platinum-resistance label.
scope_reconciliation.note: These are three different cohort scopes and two different resistance definitions (primary platinum resistance vs sensitivity at registration). They are not three corrupted versions of one number.
